- Political hostility: opposition politicians' rhetoric — social hostility, tier 3-ish, but from politicians.

The text says "punishing dissemination of homophobic information through any means" — ambiguous phrasing. Given it passed in the same session as the hate-crime amendment, likely it's an anti-hate-speech law (banning homophobic speech). Enforcement undocumented.

Actually wait — could be a "gay propaganda" law? No, "homophobic information" = information that is homophobic. I'll note ambiguity but treat as likely hate-speech prohibition, unenforced/undocumented.

Visitor-facing: no documented facility bans, no documented border friction, no documented police targeting. Document position unresolved (open question). But no documented service refusal pattern for trans visitors specifically.

Score: I'd put around 0.60-0.65. Given no criminalization, no universal exposure, functioning but slow protections, documented social disapproval and political hostility, plus unresolved document handling — somewhere between 0.55 and 0.65.
